title: oxalis griffithii subsp. formosana
intro: Oxalis griffithii subsp. formosana, commonly known as the Formosa wood sorrel, is a species of flowering plant in the wood sorrel family (Oxalidaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Oxalis griffithii subsp. formosana include its ability to act as an analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic, making it useful for treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
